steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Welcome to the Gemdrake Isles! Our island has fallen to ruin... but with your help, the dragons can come home.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Tap the Crystal Mine to dig up gems. Each tap uses 1 energy.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Drag one Pebble onto the other to merge them into a Shard!

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: I need a Shard! When an order is ready, tap it to deliver.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Coins! Let's spend them restoring the island. Tap the Island button.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Those thorny vines have to go. Tap to clear them!

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Look how much better it is already! Merge Dragon Eggs to hatch dragons. They'll earn coins for you, even while you're away.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.text: Now head back to the board and keep merging. Tap any item to see what it grows into. Have fun!
